title: Iron Archive gym (place) record
description: One canonical place per file, keyed by a namespaced, filesystem-safe place_id. Sightings reference this by place_id. Resolved once at intake so the map stays static. See CLAUDE.md and docs/model.md.

id.description: Namespaced place id; also the filename. Underscore-separated so it is filesystem-safe.

source.description: Which resolver produced this place. 'local' = a provisional id minted when no resolver matched; 'manual' = hand-entered.

merged_into.description: If this place was found to duplicate another, the canonical id it was merged into. Kept (not deleted) so references survive.
